title: Ki Dieng Bad Ka Culture Jong Ngi (Hymn of the Sacred Trees & Groves)
khasi_title: Ki Dieng Bad Ka Culture Jong Ngi
cultural_context: Chanted at the threshold of sacred groves (*Law Kyntang*) to remind travelers and kin of the inviolable sanctity of ancient oak, pine, and champa trees.

khasi: Ki dieng bah ba ieng ha ki khlaw kyntang,
Ki sumar ia ka um bad ka khyndew ka ri,
Wat kheit ia u sla, wat dung ia ka tnat,
Kynmaw ia ka niam kaba ki kpa ki pynsah.
english: The towering trees standing within sacred groves,
They preserve the pristine waters and soil of our land,
Pluck not a single leaf, break not a single bough,
Remember the sacred tradition bequeathed by our fathers.
